status: Frozen R2 full-five-fold measurement run; no further optimization until full OOF is available

training.epoch_policy: User maximum100 epochs / early-stopping7 / Adam; CNN includes a fold-train-only background prior and a trained residual mask. Epoch0 prior state remains an eligible best state as in the validated pilot.

experiment_policy: Existing development pilots are finished or quarantined. Execute the frozen complete pipeline; resume improvement only after full 5-fold OOF measurement.
loss: share MSE + explicitly logged auxiliary losses
ensemble: Fit nonnegative sum-to-one weights on inner predictions only, freeze before outer evaluation. No outer-fitted affine calibration.
final_assessment: Calibration and sealed sources remain outside this CV. Outer CV becomes development evidence after model comparison; it is not an endlessly reusable final holdout.

gpu.ram_note: Actual pod cgroup memory limit 61,999,996,928 bytes; sequential models, RTX4090 24GB validated.

dataset_policy: Original inner/outer NPZ frozen byte for byte; train support cap, reference-only EQ and clean-pool blending; evaluate full and boundary-excluded OOF. Reference support cap plus maximum synthetic added/background minute SNR 20dB; requested/effective targets recorded.
release_policy: Run all seven model families / nine candidates in fresh R2. Background-prior residual CNN is included; slow exploratory background-feature tree is excluded. No settings change based on that exploration or outer results before complete OOF.

foundation_precision_policy.default: fp32 for both candidates; explicit fp16 is an ablation only
